spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (स्तृंहति)
To hurt, to injure, to kill.

(स्तृ,) r. 5th cl. (स्तृणोति स्तृणुते)
To cover, to clothe, to spread on or over, to strew.
With वि prefixed.
1 To spread widely, to extend.
2 To be diffuse or prolix.

(स्तॄ) r. 9th cl. (स्तृणाति स्तृणीते)
To clothe, to cover, to spread on or over: see स्तृ.

mfn. (-णन्-णती-णत्)
Strewing, spreading over or upon, covering.
E.
स्तृ to strew, शतृ aff.

(ऊ) स्तृहू r. 6th cl. (स्तृहति)
To hurt, to kill; also ष्टृह, &c.

(ऊ) स्तॄहू r. 6th cl. (स्तृहति)
To hurt or kill.
